overview: The Medford Liquor License Commission reviewed and approved an outdoor dining extension, multiple one-day liquor licenses for seasonal events, an entertainment license, and an amended corporate management agreement.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: The Commission approved the meeting minutes from June 15, 2022.

items.title: Bistro 5 Alteration of Premises
items.summary: Approved an alteration of premises request for Bistro 5 to maintain seasonal outdoor sidewalk seating protected by barriers in the same footprint as prior years.

items.title: Clippership Day One-Day License
items.summary: Approved a one-day liquor license for Winter Hill Brewing Company to operate an enclosed beer garden area during the Clippership Day event.

items.title: Winter Hill Brewing One-Day Licenses
items.summary: Approved eight one-day liquor licenses for Winter Hill Brewing Company to host weekly Saturday outdoor beer gardens from September through October at 100 Winchester Street.

items.title: The Ford Management Change and Entertainment License
items.summary: Confirmed public advertisement for a change of manager and ownership interest, and approved an entertainment license for indoor and outdoor background acoustic music at The Ford Tavern.

items.title: Ocean State Job Lot Amended Management Agreement
items.summary: Approved an amended management agreement application for OSJL Spirits LLC, conditional on submitting a corrected entity vote document with the entity name filled in.
